status: proposed runtime obligations; plain data does not prove execution or deployment

scenarios.name: before-receipt-claim
assertions: Cancellation tombstone and original receipt claim decide atomically for authenticated peer UID plus target ID and digest.
Winning tombstone prevents any effect and grant; changed digest and cross-UID attempts cannot target it.

scenarios.name: full-capacity
assertions: Existing admitted cancellation remains available at full normal operation slots and tombstone budgets.
Unknown target may be refused at bounded tombstone capacity; refusal is not cancellation.

scenarios.name: after-ownership-before-effects
assertions: Bind fresh operation epoch and exact lease/workspace atomically before planning or allocation.
Short effect gate serializes cancel barrier against spawn, capture creation, filesystem mutation and publication; admission never waits on workspace flock or running Git.

scenarios.name: managed-descendants
assertions: Exercise real managed descendants, controller death and restart.
Retain intent and operation_in_doubt when exact scopes, provenance, or continuation revocation cannot be proven; timeouts never establish fence.

scenarios.name: completion-race
assertions: Durable finalization wins or cancellation barrier wins atomically.
Completed receipt remains exact historical receipt; cancellation winner prevents fresh grant and any later admitted effect.

scenarios.name: later-owner-and-same-token
assertions: Late cancel must compare original operation identity, epoch, workspace and recorded authority within stop gate.
Do not stop replacement owner, reused workspace key, repaired initialization or later operation on same token.

scenarios.name: restart-and-sql-fault
assertions: Fault SQL commits before and after ownership, gate and finalization; preserve unknown execution outcomes.
Restart reconciles evidence without redispatching payload, hooks, creation or pushes.

scenarios.name: partial-publication
assertions: Preserve already published refs, files, journals, receipts and quota.
Cancellation does not checkpoint, rollback, release, retire quota, or acquire ownership.
